value: US Bankruptcy Court, Southern District of Texas, Houston Division, Case 23-90342 (CML)
Split into two independent companies: AmSurg and Envision Physician Services (EVPS)
Former creditors led by PIMCO, with Blackstone and Brigade Capital among others, via debt-to-equity conversion

Original $3.5B controlling equity commitment eliminated. Residual stake disputed across sources: one report states KKR retained a minority stake in AmSurg; another states KKR retains no ownership of either company. Both shown; not resolved here.
